vid_urls.title: Live: SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launches Bandwagon-5 rideshare mission from Cape Canaveral
vid_urls.description:
Watch live coverage as SpaceX launches a Falcon 9 rocket carrying multiple payloads on the Bandwagon-5 ride-share mission. Liftoff from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is scheduled for Tuesday, Oct. 20, at 6:30 a.m. EDT (1030 UTC). 

The first stage booster, tail number B1085, launching for a 19th time, will target a landing on the drone ship 'A Shortfall of Gravitas'.

The mission will take a south-easterly trajectory on departure from Florida's Space Coast.

Commentary will be provided by Spaceflight Now's Will Robinson-Smith, starting approximately an hour prior to liftoff.
